titles.romaji: 3-byougo, Yajuu.: Goukon de Sumi ni Ita Kare wa Midara na Nikushoku deshita
titles.english: 3 Seconds Later, He Turned Into a Beast
titles.native: 3秒後、野獣。～合コンで隅にいた彼は淫らな肉食でした

description:
Freshly arrived in Tokyo, Tsumugi had only bad experiences with guys from the capital... Could it be that she had found the kind and serious boy she was looking for in Kaname? Or did she once again throw herself into the arms of a playboy...?

(Source: Coolmic)
